item.title: Mexico’s ambassador welcomes joint trade cooperation committee with Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Mexico’s ambassador to Tehran, Guillermo Puente Ordorica, has welcomed the formation of a joint Iran-Mexico committee to expand trade relations, identifying health tourism, the automotive industry and auto parts manufacturing as potential areas of cooperation.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86256598/Mexico-s-ambassador-welcomes-joint-trade-cooperation-committee

Tehran, IRNA – Mexico’s ambassador to Tehran, Guillermo Puente Ordorica, has welcomed the formation of a joint Iran-Mexico committee to expand trade relations, identifying health tourism, the automotive industry and auto parts manufacturing as potential areas of cooperation.

item.title: US military cannot call its ‘barbaric crimes’ against civilians a ‘mistake’: Iran’s OIC mission
item.description: Tehran, IRNA –Iran’s mission to the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) has denounced the US military for proudly acknowledging yet another “cowardly and illegal attack” on an Iranian oil tanker, while evading responsibility for the killing of civilians.

item.title: In photos: Int’l congresses on stem cells and biomedicine held in Iran
item.description: The “27th Reproductive Biomedicine” and the “22nd Congress on Stem Cell Biology and Technology,” organized by the Royan Institute, were held in Tehran on September 2, 2026. item.title: In photos: Entrepreneurship festival held in Iran
item.description: The second edition of the Alavi Empowerment and Entrepreneurship Festival, along with a ceremony celebrating the launch of 150,000 employment projects, was held on September 5, 2026, at the Imam Khomeini Camp Complex in Lavasan, Tehran Province. Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref was in attendance.
